verbatim_quote.original: من بتونم بر اساس استاتوس کرشها، کرشها رو سورت کنم یا فیلتر کنم توی ادمین پنل. این میتونه خودش یه تسک جدا باشه.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: I want to be able to sort or filter crashes by crash status in the admin panel. That can be its own separate task.

extracted_decision.summary: Add status sort/filter to the admin crashes page; it can be its own separate task.
extracted_decision.rationale: Manager wants to sort/filter crashes by status.
